property_summary: For any caller address and any amount, when the caller is the contract owner the call to sendTo(receiver, amount) does not revert if the receiver is a contract whose fallback/receive accepts ETH (i.e., a normal payable recipient); the mutant that always reverts breaks this by causing the call to revert for an owner call to such a recipient.
change_summary: Replaced the transfer with reverting unconditionally, preventing the transfer and changing observable behavior by always reverting.
